fieldData.description: To celebrate 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink & food with your fellow Philippines community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food, drinks for everyone. Feel free to reach out to @brainRekt on Telegram for any clarification and join the Philippines community https://t.me/radix_Ph
fieldData.location: Kamay Kainan Plus 26th Street Taguig, NCR 1634 Philippines
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Manila
